headline: Grayscale's New Zcash ETF Amasses $1 Billion in Assets Within 30 Days
summary: Grayscale's new Zcash exchange-traded fund gathered $1 billion in assets during its first 30 days, driven by strong investor interest in the privacy coin.
why: Rapid capital inflows into specialized crypto exchange-traded products indicate institutional demand and shifting investor sentiment toward alternative digital assets.

impacts.name: Zcash
impacts.why: Strong asset accumulation in an ETF format increases direct demand for the underlying cryptocurrency.

why_moved: Substantial capital inflows into a new crypto product signal heightened speculative or institutional demand for privacy-focused digital assets.
